description: Source code for MediaKeySession class handling DRM session management, key handling, and decryption, specific to ClearKey and CENC initialization data, with platform-specific AES encryption support.

classes.name: MediaKeySession
classes.description: Handles DRM media key sessions, including creation, updating, decryption, and key management.

methods.name: CreateSessionId
methods.description: Generates a unique session ID based on a static counter.

methods.name: MediaKeySession
methods.description: Constructor initializing session with init data, parsing clear key or CENC data.

methods.name: ~MediaKeySession
methods.description: Destructor managing platform-specific crypto session cleanup.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the session, optionally with a callback, spawning a thread for message handling.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates session keys from response data, triggers key status updates.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of data using AES CTR mode with support for platform-specific crypto.

methods.name: KeyIdsToJSON
methods.description: Serializes key IDs to JSON format.

methods.name: ParseClearKeyInitializationData
methods.description: Parses init data to extract key IDs or CENC data.

methods.name: ParseKeyIdsInitData
methods.description: Parses JSON init data for key IDs.

methods.name: ParseCENCInitData
methods.description: Parses CENC init data to extract key IDs and PSSH data.
